DA_KickStart.description: Gain a random <TFTCurveTable row="StarLevel"/>-star <TFTCurveTable row="ChampCost"/>-cost champion and <TFTCurveTable row="NumGold"/> gold.

DA_Kingslayer.description: After winning player combat, gain <TFTCurveTable row="BaseGoldAfterCombat"/> gold. If they had more health than you, gain <TFTCurveTable row="ModifiedGoldAfterCombat"/> Gold instead. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="InitialGold"/> gold.

DA_KnowYourEnemy.description: You can see who you will fight next. Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="DefaultDamageAmp" format="percent"/> Damage Amp, increased to <TFTCurveTable row="SharedTraitDamageAmp" format="percent"/> if you and your opponent have any of the same traits active.

DA_LateGameScaling.description:
Gain <TFTCurveTable row="XPGain"/> XP at the start of player combat rounds. Your 5-cost champions gain <TFTCurveTable row="ChampBuff" format="percentMinusOne"/> Health and <TFTCurveTable row="ChampBuff" format="percentMinusOne"/> Attack Speed.

<Rules>Cyber City Tactician's Crown, 2025</>

DA_LateGameSpecialist.description: When you reach Level <TFTCurveTable row="LevelReq"/>, gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumGold"/> gold.

DA_LevelUp.description: When you buy XP, gain an additional <TFTCurveTable row="AdditionalXP"/>. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="InstantXP"/> immediately.

DA_Lineup.description: Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="ArmorPerAlly"/> Armor and Magic Resist for each ally that starts combat in the front <TFTCurveTable row="NumRowsAtFront"/> rows.

DA_MakeshiftArmorI.description: Champions without items equipped gain <TFTCurveTable row="Armor_Silver"/> Armor and Magic Resist.

DA_MakeshiftArmorII.description: Champions without items equipped gain <TFTCurveTable row="Armor_Gold"/> Armor and Magic Resist.

DA_MaliciousMonetization.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="InstantGold"/> gold. For the next <TFTCurveTable row="Duration"/> rounds, enemy champions drop <TFTCurveTable row="GoldPerEnemy"/> gold when killed.

DA_MissedConnections.description: Gain a copy of each 1-cost champion.

DA_MoneyHungry_NotBroken.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="InitialGold"/> gold now, then <TFTCurveTable row="GoldPerStage"/> gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.

DA_MoneyHungryPlus.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="InitialGoldPlus"/> gold now, then <TFTCurveTable row="GoldPerStagePlus"/> gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.

DA_MoneyMonsoon.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="GoldPerRoundMonsoon"/> gold now and every round for the rest of the game.

DA_NestingDolls.description: After a champion dies in combat, spawn a copy of them one star level lower with <TFTCurveTable row="HealthMultiplier" format="percent"/> health. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumRerolls"/> free rerolls.

DA_NestingDollsPlus.description: After a champion dies in combat, spawn a copy of them one star level lower with <TFTCurveTable row="HealthMultiplier" format="percent"/> health. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumRerolls"/> free rerolls.

DA_NestingDollsPlusPlus.description: After a champion dies in combat, spawn a copy of them one star level lower with <TFTCurveTable row="HealthMultiplier" format="percent"/> health. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumRerolls"/> free rerolls.

DA_NoScoutNoPivot.description: Champions that fight in player combat cannot be benched or sold. Your team gains <TFTCurveTable format="percent" row="PostCombatHealthBoost"/> Health, and <TFTCurveTable format="percent" row="PostCombatApBoost"/> Attack Damage and Ability Power after player combat.

DA_PandorasBench.description: At the start of every round, champions on the <TFTCurveTable row="NumBenchSlots"/> rightmost bench slots transform into random champions of the same cost. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="GoldGain"/> gold.

DA_PatienceIsAVirtue.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="RerollsUpfront"/> rerolls now. Each round, gain <TFTCurveTable row="Rerolls"/> free reroll if you did not buy a champion last round.

DA_PatientStudy.description: After player combat, gain <TFTCurveTable row="XPBonusWin"/> XP if you won or <TFTCurveTable row="XPBonusLose"/> XP if you lost.

DA_PlotArmor.description: Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="ArmorInstant"/> Armor and Magic Resist. After falling below <TFTCurveTable row="HealthDropThreshold" format="Percent"/> Health, increase this to <TFTCurveTable row="ThresholdArmorBoostCombined"/> for the rest of combat.

DA_PrismaticTicket.description: Each time your shop is rerolled you have a <TFTCurveTable row="PrismaticChance"/>% chance to gain a free reroll.

DA_QuickStreaks.description: You gain twice as much progress towards win and loss streaks. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold.

DA_ShoppingSpree.description: When you level up, gain a number of Shop refreshes equal to your level +<TFTCurveTable row="BonusRollPerLevel"/>. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="GoldGain"/> gold.

DA_SliceOfLife.description: Twice per stage, gain a random champion. Its cost increases by Stage. This effect ends after receiving <TFTCurveTable row="NumOfMaxCosts"/> <TFTCurveTable row="MaxChampCost"/>-cost champion.

DA_SoulAwakening.description: Combat start: Your team gains <TFTCurveTable format="percent" row="CombatStartAdBoost"/> Attack Damage and Ability Power per second for <TFTCurveTable row="NumRepeatsAfterInitialApplication"/> seconds. At max stacks, deal <TFTCurveTable format="percent" row="TrueDamage"/> bonus true damage.

DA_StandUnited.description: Your units gain <TFTCurveTable row="AttackDamagePercentagePerTrait" format="percent"/> Attack Damage and <TFTCurveTable row="AbilityPowerPerTrait" format="percent"/> Ability Power for each non-unique Trait active across your team.

DA_SubscriptionService.description: Now and at the start of each stage, open a shop of <TFTCurveTable row="UnitsInShop"/> unique <TFTCurveTable row="UnitCost"/>-cost champions and gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold.

DA_TimeSkip.description: Disable your Shop for the next <TFTCurveTable row="RoundsSkipped"/> rounds. Then gain <TFTCurveTable row="ExperienceToAdd"/> XP.

DA_TonsOfStatsI.description: Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="Health"/> Health, <TFTCurveTable row="ADAP" format="percent"/> Attack Damage, <TFTCurveTable row="ADAP" format="percent"/> Ability Power, <TFTCurveTable row="Resists"/> Armor, <TFTCurveTable row="Resists"/> Magic Resist, <TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeed" format="percentMinusOne"/> Attack Speed, and <TFTCurveTable row="Mana"/> Mana.

DA_TonsOfStatsII.description: Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="Health"/> Health, <TFTCurveTable row="ADAP" format="percent"/> Attack Damage, <TFTCurveTable row="ADAP" format="percent"/> Ability Power, <TFTCurveTable row="Resists"/> Armor, <TFTCurveTable row="Resists"/> Magic Resist, <TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeed" format="percentMinusOne"/> Attack Speed, and <TFTCurveTable row="Mana"/> Mana.

DA_TradeSector.description: Gain a Shop reroll every round. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumGold"/> gold.

DA_TradeSectorPlus.description: Gain a Shop reroll every round. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumGoldPlus"/> gold.

DA_TwinGuardians.description: If you have exactly <TFTCurveTable row="NumMultiples"/> allies in your first row, grant them <TFTCurveTable row="BonusHealth"/> Health, <TFTCurveTable row="ArmorInstant"/> Armor, and <TFTCurveTable row="MagicResistInstant"/> Magic Resist.

DA_UpwardMobility.description: Buying XP costs <TFTCurveTable row="ReducedXPCost"/> less. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="HealthOnLevelUp"/> Health and <TFTCurveTable row="RerollsOnLevelUp"/> Shop rerolls whenever you level up.

DA_VerticalityI.description: Champions gain <TFTCurveTable row="ADAP" format="percent"/> Attack Damage, <TFTCurveTable row="ADAP" format="percent"/> Ability Power, <TFTCurveTable row="resists"/> Armor, and <TFTCurveTable row="resists"/> Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

DA_VerticalityII.description: Champions gain <TFTCurveTable row="ADAP" format="percent"/> Attack Damage, <TFTCurveTable row="ADAP" format="percent"/> Ability Power, <TFTCurveTable row="resists"/> Armor, and <TFTCurveTable row="resists"/> Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

DA_VerticalityIII.description: Champions gain <TFTCurveTable row="ADAP" format="percent"/> Attack Damage, <TFTCurveTable row="ADAP" format="percent"/> Ability Power, <TFTCurveTable row="resists"/> Armor, and <TFTCurveTable row="resists"/> Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

DA_WorththeWait.description: Gain a random 1-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

DA_WorththeWaitII.description: Gain 2 copies of a random 2-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

DA_YoungAndWildAndFree.description: You can always move freely on Carousel rounds. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="InstantGold"/> gold.

DA_BackupBows.description: Gain a Recurve Bow. After your champions attack <TFTCurveTable row="AttackCount"/> times, get <TFTCurveTable row="NumBows"/> more.

DA_BandOfThievesII.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="AmountOfGlovesAtStartII"/> Thief's Gloves. After <TFTCurveTable row="CombatsUntilNextRewardII"/> player combats, gain another.

DA_BandOfThievesIIPlus.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="AmountOfGlovesAtStartII+"/> Thief's Gloves. After <TFTCurveTable row="CombatsUntilNextRewardII+"/> player combats, gain another.

DA_BandOfThievesIIPlusPlus.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="AmountOfGlovesAtStartII++"/> Thief's Gloves. After <TFTCurveTable row="CombatsUntilNextRewardII++"/> player combats, gain another.

DA_BaronsLair.description:
Gain a random Tank item. After <TFTCurveTable row="StartSeconds"/> seconds of combat, your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="Stats" format="percent"/> bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power every second for the rest of combat.

<Rules>TFT Paris Open, 2025</>

DA_BeltOverflow.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumBelts"/> Giant's Belts. Your Giant's Belts grant +<TFTCurveTable row="BonusHealthPerBelt"/> bonus Health.

DA_BirthdayReunion.description:
Gain a random <TFTCurveTable row="ChampLevel"/>-star <TFTCurveTable row="FirstRewardShopTier"/>-cost champion. At Level <TFTCurveTable row="MiddleRewardLevel"/>, gain a random item component. At Level <TFTCurveTable row="LastRewardLevel"/>, gain a random <TFTCurveTable row="ChampLevel"/>-star <TFTCurveTable row="LastRewardShopTier"/>-cost champion.

<Rules>Inkborn Fables Tactician's Crown, 2024</>

DA_BuriedTreasuresIII.description: Gain a random item component now and at the start of the next <TFTCurveTable row="RoundsDuration"/> rounds.

DA_CallToChaos.description: Gain a powerful and random reward.

DA_CaretakersFavor.description:
Gain a component anvil when you reach level 5, 6, 7, and 8.

<Rules>Component anvils offer 4 choices.</>

DA_CarveAPath.description: Gain a B.F. Sword. After your champions deal <TFTCurveTable row="PhysicalDamageUntilCompletion"/> physical damage, gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumCompletionRewards"/> more.

DA_Staffsmith.description: Gain  <TFTCurveTable row="ItemQuantity"/> random completed items that build from Needlessly Large Rod.

DA_Swordsmith.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="ItemQuantity"/> random completed items that build from B.F. Sword.

DA_CognitiveOverload.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumGold"/> gold, <TFTCurveTable row="NumChamp"/> <TFTCurveTable row="ChampLevel"/>-star <TFTCurveTable row="ChampCost"/>-cost champion, <TFTCurveTable row="NumChamp2"/> <TFTCurveTable row="ChampCost2"/>-cost champion, <TFTCurveTable row="NumChamp3"/> <TFTCurveTable row="ChampCost3"/>-cost champions, <TFTCurveTable row="NumXP"/> XP, and <TFTCurveTable row="NumRerolls"/> Shop reroll.

DA_ComponentBuffet.description: Whenever you would get a component, gain a component anvil instead. Gain a random component.The anvil offers 4 choices.

DA_ComponentQuest.description: Gain a random component and <TFTCurveTable row="NumGold"/> gold. The next 7 times you win a player combat, gain a different random component. Afterwards, gain <TFTCurveTable row="CompletionGold"/> gold.

DA_CookingPot.description: At the start of each turn, all allies holding a Frying Pan or Spatula item grant the nearest champion <TFTCurveTable row="HealthIncrease"/> permanent Health. Gain a Frying Pan.

DA_Coronation.description: Gain a Tactician's Crown. Tactician's Crown, Cape, and Shield grant the holder <TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeed" format="percentminusone"/> Attack Speed, <TFTCurveTable row="AttackDamage" format="percent"/> Attack Damage, and <TFTCurveTable row="AbilityPower" format="percent"/> Ability Power.

DA_CraftedCrafting.description: Whenever you craft a completed item, gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumFreeRerolls"/> rerolls.

DA_CryMeARiver.description: Gain a Tear of the Goddess. Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="RegenBonus"/> Mana Regen. After <TFTCurveTable row="UpgradeDelay"/> seconds in combat, increase this to <TFTCurveTable row="UpgradedRegenBonus"/>.

DA_CyberneticImplants_Gold.description: Your champions holding an item gain <TFTCurveTable row="HPFromGold"/> Health and <TFTCurveTable row="ADFromGold" format="percent"/> Attack Damage. Gain a B.F. Sword.

DA_CyberneticUplink_Gold.description: Your champions holding an item gain <TFTCurveTable row="HPFromGold"/> Health and <TFTCurveTable row="ManaRegenFromGold"/> Mana Regen. Gain a Tear of the Goddess.

DA_DeadlierBlades.description: Gain a Deathblade. Deathblades permanently gain <TFTCurveTable row="AttackDamagePercent" format="percent"/> Attack Damage whenever their holders score a takedown.

DA_DeadlierCaps.description: Gain a Rabadon's Deathcap. Rabadon's Deathcaps grant <TFTCurveTable row="ManaGen"/> Mana Regen and permanently gain <TFTCurveTable row="AbilityPowerPercent" format="percent"/> Ability Power whenever their holders score a takedown.

DA_Dummify.description: Lose all champions on your board and bench. Gain a Training Dummy with <TFTCurveTable row="CombinedHealthPercentage" format="percent"/> of their combined health. The dummy gains <TFTCurveTable row="HealthGainPerStage"/> Health per stage. Gain a random non-tank 2-star 2 cost champion.

DA_ExclusiveCustomization.description: Gain a Lucky Item Chest, a Magnetic Remover and <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold.

DA_Expedition.description: At the start of every round, lose the champion in the rightmost bench slot. After losing <TFTCurveTable row="CashoutCost"/> gold of champions in this way, gain a powerful reward. Gain a 3-cost champion now.

DA_ExtraBuckles.description: Gain a Giant's Belt. After your champions take <TFTCurveTable row="DamageTakenReq"/> damage, get <TFTCurveTable row="NumCashoutLoot"/> more.

DA_Flexible.description: Gain 1 random Emblem. At the start of every Stage, gain a random Emblem. Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="Health"/> Health for each Emblem they are holding.

DA_FlowingTears.description: Gain a Tear of the Goddess. After your champions spend <TFTCurveTable row="CompletionManaRequired"/> Mana, gain <TFTCurveTable row="CompletionNumRewards"/> more.

DA_ForgedInStrength.description:
Gain <TFTCurveTable row="InitialArtifacts"/> random Artifact. When you drop below <TFTCurveTable row="Health"/> Health, gain <TFTCurveTable row="MoreArtifacts"/> more random Artifact, <TFTCurveTable row="MoreCompletedItems"/> random completed item, and <TFTCurveTable row="MoreComponents"/> random components.

<Rules>Remix Rumble Championship, 2023</>

DA_GoldenEgg.description: Gain a golden egg that hatches in <TFTCurveTable row="Rounds"/> turns for a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat speeds up the hatch timer by an extra turn.

DA_GoldenGamble.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumAnvils"/> Completed Item anvils.

DA_GoldenGamblePlus.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumAnvils"/> Completed Item anvils.

DA_GoldenGamblePlusPlus.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumAnvils"/> Completed Item anvils.

DA_HardCommit.description: Gain a random emblem. Now and at the start of each stage, gain a 1-star champion of that trait with a cost equal to the Stage (max 5) and 3 gold.

DA_HeartOfSteel.description: Gain a Steadfast Heart. Every <TFTCurveTable row="SurvivePeriodInSeconds"/> seconds of combat its holder survives, Steadfast Heart gains additional <TFTCurveTable row="MaxHealthGain"/> permanent max Health.

DA_HeroicGrabBag.description: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold.

DA_HeroicGrabBagPlus.description: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold.

DA_HeroicGrabBagPlusPlus.description: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold.

DA_InfinityProtection.description:
Gain <TFTCurveTable row="GoldAmount"/> gold now. On Stage <TFTCurveTable row="UnlockStage"/>-<TFTCurveTable row="UnlockRound"/>, gain an Infinity Force. Infinity Force gives allies in the same row a <TFTCurveTable row="HealthPercent" format="percent"/> Health shield.

<Rules>Monsters Attack Championship, 2023</>

DA_InvestedPlus.description: Gain 26 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).

DA_InvestedPlusPlus.description: Gain 45 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).

DA_IronAssets.description: Gain a component anvil and <TFTCurveTable row="NumCoins"/> gold.

DA_LatentForge.description: After <TFTCurveTable row="WaitRounds"/>  player combats, gain an Artifact anvil.

DA_LegionOfThrees.description:
Gain a random Emblem. Your 3-cost champions and all allies equipped with an Emblem gain <TFTCurveTable row="HealthMaxAdd"/> Health and <TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeedPercent" format="percentMinusOne"/> Attack Speed.

<Rules>Reckoning Championship, 2021</>

DA_LivingForge.description: Gain an Artifact Anvil now and after every <TFTCurveTable row="RoundCounter"/> player combats.

DA_LuckyGloves.description: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="StartSparringGlovesAmount"/> Sparring Gloves and <TFTCurveTable row="gold"/> gold.

DA_LuckyGlovesPlus.description: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="StartSparringGlovesAmount"/> Sparring Gloves now, then another after <TFTCurveTable row="CombatsUntilNextReward+"/> player combats.

DA_LuxurySubscription.description:
Gain a package containing a <TFTCurveTable row="1StarCost"/>-cost champion, a 2-star <TFTCurveTable row="2StarCost"/>-cost champion, and <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold.

At the start of the next <TFTCurveTable row="Stages"/> stages, gain the package again.

DA_ExpectedUnexpectedness.description: Now and at the start of the next 2 stages, roll 3 dice. Gain various rewards based on their total.

DA_MagicRoll.description:
Roll 3 dice. Gain rewards based on their total.

{Augment.Variant.MagicRoll.Reward}

DA_SlightlyMagicRoll.description:
Roll a die. Gain rewards based on the number rolled.

{Augment.Variant.SlightlyMagicRoll.Reward}

DA_MaxBuild.description:
Gain <TFTCurveTable row="Rerolls"/> free Shop rerolls. When you reach level <TFTCurveTable row="Level"/>, gain <TFTCurveTable row="RewardRolls"/> free Shop rerolls and a Champion Duplicator.

<Rules>Galaxies Championship, 2020</>

DA_Min_Max.description: Gain a Golden Item Remover, 4 random components, and <TFTCurveTable row="GoldAmount"/> gold.

DA_NestingAnvils.description: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After you open it, gain a Component Anvil. After you open that, gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold.

DA_NestingAnvilsPlus.description: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After you open it, gain a Component Anvil. After you open that, gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold.

DA_OneBuffTwoBuff.description: Gain a Red Buff, a Blue Buff, and a Champion Duplicator.

DA_PandorasItemsI.description:
Round start: items on your bench are randomized. 

Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumberOfComponentsI"/> random component.

DA_PandorasItemsII.description:
Round start: items on your bench are randomized. 

Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumberOfComponentsII"/> random components and <TFTCurveTable row="GoldAmountII"/> gold.

DA_PandorasItemsIII.description:
Round start: items on your bench are randomized. 

Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumberOfRadiantItemsIII"/> Radiant item.

DA_Pilfer.description: Each round, gain a 1-star copy of the first champion you killed last combat. The first time you gain <TFTCurveTable row="GoldForGloves"/> gold worth of champions in this way, gain a Thief's Gloves.

DA_PortableForge.description: Choose 1 of 4 Artifacts. Artifacts are more powerful items with a unique effect.

DA_PromisedProtection.description: Gain a Protector's Vow. Protector's Vow grants its holder <TFTCurveTable row="IncomingManaIncreasePercentage" format="percent"/> additional Mana from all sources and <TFTCurveTable row="FlatHP"/> max Health.

DA_RadiantRascal.description: Gain a Radiant Thief's Gloves item. This equips 2 random Radiant items every round.

DA_RadiantRelic.description: Choose 1 of 5 Radiant Items. Gain a Magnetic Remover.

DA_Recombobulator.description: Champions on your board permanently transform into random champions 1 cost tier higher (max 5). Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumRemovers"/> Magnetic Removers and <TFTCurveTable row="NumRolls"/> free rerolls.

DA_Replication.description: Choose 1 of 3 components. For the next <TFTCurveTable row="NumberOfRoundsToGrantLoot"/> rounds, gain a copy of that component.

DA_Retribution.description:
Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumItemsToGrant"/> Hands of Justice. Allies equipped with Hand of Justice gain <Keyword>Precision</> and <TFTCurveTable row="CriticalStrikeChance" format="percent"/> Critical Strike Chance.

<Rules>Precision: Ability damage can critically strike. Additional Precision grants 10% Critical Strike Damage.</>

DA_SalvageBin.description: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after <TFTCurveTable row="Rounds"/> player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

DA_SalvageBinPlus.description: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after <TFTCurveTable row="RoundsPlus"/> player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

DA_SeraphimsStaff.description: Gain an Archangel's Staff. Archangel's Staff grants <TFTCurveTable row="ManaPerSecond"/> additional Mana Regen if its holder has <TFTCurveTable row="APThreshold" format="percentMinusOne"/> or more Ability Power.

DA_ShimmerscaleEssence.description: Gain a Gambler's Blade. After <TFTCurveTable row="NumberOfRoundsToWait"/> player combats, gain a Mogul's Mail.

DA_Slammin.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumGold"/> gold. After each player combat, if there are no items on your bench (other than consumables), gain <TFTCurveTable row="NoItemsXP"/> XP.

DA_SlamminPlus.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumGold+"/> gold and <TFTCurveTable row="InstantXP+"/> XP now. After each player combat, if there are no items on your bench (other than consumables), gain <TFTCurveTable row="NoItemsXP+"/> XP.

DA_SoloLeveling.description: For the next <TFTCurveTable row="NumCombats"/> combats, your team size is <TFTCurveTable row="MaxTeamSize"/>, but the champion you field has massively increased stats. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="XPPerKill"/> XP for every kill they get. Afterwards, gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumComponents"/> item components.

DA_SoloPlate.description: Gain a Gargoyle Stoneplate. Allies holding Gargoyle Stoneplate gain <TFTCurveTable row="MaxHealthPercent" format="percentMinusOne"/> max Health if they start combat alone in their row.

DA_SpeedyDoubleKill.description:
Gain a Guinsoo's Rageblade. When <TFTCurveTable row="NumEliminationsRequired"/> players are eliminated, gain <TFTCurveTable row="GoldAmount"/> gold.

<Rules>Fates Championship, 2021</>

DA_SpiritOfRedemption.description: Gain a Spirit Visage. Every <TFTCurveTable row="TimeIntervalSeconds"/> seconds, Spirit Visage heals allies within <TFTCurveTable row="HexRange"/> hex for <TFTCurveTable row="PercentMissingHealth" format="percent"/> of their missing Health.

DA_SpreadingRoots.description: Gain a random Emblems. After <TFTCurveTable row="Delay"/> combats, gain another.

DA_SpreadingRootsPlus.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="EmblemAmount+"/> random Emblems and <TFTCurveTable row="GoldAmount+"/> gold.

DA_StarringUp.description: After 3-starring <TFTCurveTable row="NumChamps"/> champions, set your level to <TFTCurveTable row="RewardLevel"/>. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumRerolls"/> rerolls now and at the start of every round.

DA_SweetTreats.description: Gain an Artifact anvil. Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="BonusHealth"/> Health for each item equipped on champions.

DA_SwordOverflow.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumBFSwords"/> BF Swords. Your BF Swords grant +<TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeedPerSword" format="percent"/> Attack Speed.

DA_TacticiansKitchen.description: Gain a random Emblem. After <TFTCurveTable row="Rounds"/> rounds, gain a Tactician's Cape.

DA_TeamBuilding.description:
Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator. Gain another after <TFTCurveTable row="PlayerRounds"/> player combats.

<Rules>This item allows you to copy a 3-cost or less champion.</>

DA_TheGoldenDragon.description:
Gain a Mogul's Mail. Champions holding Mogul's Mail take up +<TFTCurveTable row="IncreasedTeamSizeContribution"/> team slot but gain <TFTCurveTable row="BonusHealth"/> Health and <TFTCurveTable row="BonusDurability" format="percent"/> Durability.

<Rules>Mogul's Mail gives gold as well as combat power.</>
<Rules>Dragonlands Championship, 2022</>

DA_TheTower.description: Gain a giant Training Dummy. Every <TFTCurveTable row="TowerAttackInterval"/> seconds, it zaps the <TFTCurveTable row="TowerNumTargets"/> nearest enemies dealing <TFTCurveTable format="percent" row="MaxHealthDamageMultiplier"/> max Health true damage.

DA_TheTraitTree.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="EmblemAmount"/> random Emblems and <TFTCurveTable row="GoldAmount"/> gold.

DA_TheTraitTreePlus.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="EmblemAmount+"/> random Emblems, a Reforger, and <TFTCurveTable row="GoldAmount+"/> gold.

DA_TraitLadder.description: Gain a random emblem. After fielding <TFTCurveTable row="LowestTraitBreakpoint"/> non-unique traits in a player combat, gain a reward. Then increase the number of traits needed and the size of the reward.

DA_URF.description: Gain a Spatula. Champions holding Spatula or Frying Pan items gain <TFTCurveTable row="AS" format="percent"/> Attack Speed and <TFTCurveTable row="ManaRegen"/> Mana Regen.

DA_UrfsGrabBag.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumSpats"/> Spatula, <TFTCurveTable row="NumComponents"/> random components, and <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold.

DA_WandOverflow.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="NumRods"/> Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant +<TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeedPerRod" format="percent"/> Attack Speed.

DA_Warpath.description: Gain a 2-star 2-cost champion. After dealing <TFTCurveTable row="PlayerDamage"/> player damage, gain a chest of high cost champions and items.

DA_WeStickTogether.description:
Gain a random Emblem and a completed item anvil. Allies that share a trait with that Emblem gain <TFTCurveTable format="percentMinusOne" row="AttackSpeed"/> Attack Speed. {Augment.Variant.WeStickTogether.Tooltip} {Augment.Variant.WeStickTogether.Trait}

<Rules>Into The Arcane Tactician's Crown, 2025</>

DA_WovenMagic.description: Gain a random item component. Every <TFTCurveTable row="ManaPerComponent"/> Mana spent by your champions, grants an additional component (max: <TFTAttribute attributeId="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1"/>/<TFTCurveTable row="NumberOfComponents"/>).

DA_18_BigGrabBag.description: Gain 3 random components, <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold, and 1 Reforger.

DA_BonusGift.description: Whenever you open a loot orb, you have a <TFTCurveTable row="Chance" format="Percent"/> chance to gain a gray loot orb. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="StartingOrbs"/> gray loot orbs.

DA_BonusGiftPlus.description: Whenever you open a loot orb, you have a <TFTCurveTable row="Chance" format="Percent"/> chance to gain a gray loot orb. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="StartingOrbs"/> gray loot orbs.

DA_18_BranchingOutPlus.description: Gain a random Emblem and a Reforger.

DA_18_CaretakersAlly.description:
Gain a random 2-cost champion now. Gain the same one again every time you level up.

<Rules>Champion: {Set18.Augment.CaretakersAllyChampion}</>

DA_18_DuoQueue.description: Gain 2 random 5-cost champions and 2 copies of a random component.

DA_18_FOURcing.description: Gain a random 4-cost champion. For each item equipped to that champion, your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="Health"/> health.

DA_18_GoodForSomethingI.description: Champions that aren't holding items have a <TFTCurveTable row="ChangeDrop" format="percent"/> chance to drop <TFTCurveTable row="GoldReward"/> gold on death.

DA_LoadedDice.description:
Your dice and coins are luckier.

Roll a die and gain gold equal to the number rolled. Then flip a coin and gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold if you flip heads.

DA_18_OnesTwosThree.description: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="OneCosts"/> 1-cost champions, <TFTCurveTable row="TwoCosts"/> 2-cost champion, and <TFTCurveTable row="ThreeCosts"/> 3-cost champion.

DA_18_OneTwoFive.description: Gain 1 random component, <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold, and 1 random 5-cost champion.

DA_18_ResidualMagic.description: Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="InitialHealth"/> Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by <TFTCurveTable row="HealthPerSprite"/>.

DA_18_ResidualMagicPlus.description: Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="InitialHealth"/> Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by <TFTCurveTable row="HealthPerSprite"/>.

DA_18_ResidualMagicPlusPlus.description: Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="InitialHealth"/> Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by <TFTCurveTable row="HealthPerSprite"/>.

DA_18_WeightTheWorth.description: The first time you 3-star a champion, gain a copy of them each round for the rest of the game. 3-starring the same champion again grants additional copies. Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator.

DA_18_WispRebate.description: Each time you purchase a Wisp, gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="StartingGold"/> gold now.

DA_18_WispRebatePlus.description: Each time you purchase a Wisp, gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="StartingGold"/> gold now.

DA_18_WispRebatePlusPlus.description: Each time you purchase a Wisp, gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="StartingGold"/> gold now.

DA_18_LuxAugmentII.description:
Open an armory and choose one of  <TFTCurveTable row="ArmoryChoices"/> traits. Gain a Lux with that trait and a Spear of Shojin.

<dim>Traits on your board are more likely to appear in the armory. Lux provides +2 to her chosen trait</>

DA_BlackthornTraitAugment.description: The first <TFTCurveTable row="NumComponents"/> times you sacrifice a champion in the Blackthorn hex, gain a copy of a random component they're holding. Gain an Azir, Veigar, and a Rek'Sai.

DA_18_BlossomTraitAugment.description: When you buy a Wisp, gain a random Blossom champion based on the Wisp's cost. Gain a Yunara, a Yorick, and a Karma.

DA_18_CovenTraitAugment.description: When you choose to continue gathering Coven essence, heal <TFTCurveTable row="Health"/> Tactician health. Gain a Camille, an Elise, and a Caitlyn.

DA_18_CovenTraitAugment_LootToAP.description: Converting Coven Essence to rewards grants Coven champions Ability Power instead of loot. Gain a Camille, an Elise, and a Caitlyn.

DA_18_ElderwoodTraitAugment.description: Champions that start combat adjacent to an Elderwood plant gain <TFTCurveTable row="AS" format="PercentMinusOne"/> Attack Speed and heal <TFTCurveTable row="heal" format="percent"/> of their maximum Health every <TFTCurveTable row="HealInterval"/> seconds. Gain an Alistar, an Ornn, and a Xayah.

DA_18_FaeTraitAugment.description: Fae pixies are now larger and grant <TFTCurveTable row="BonusMultiplier" format="percent"/> more Attack Damage and Ability Power. Fae champions gain <TFTCurveTable row="UpfrontADAP" format="percent"/> Attack Damage and Ability Power immediately. Gain a Xayah and a Rakan.

DA_18_FloraFatalisAugment.description: Gain a Flora Fatalis emblem. The champion holding the emblem gains <TFTCurveTable row="ExtraEffectiveness" format="percent"/> increased benefits from Flora Fatalis. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="Gold"/> gold.

DA_18_InfernoTraitAugment.description: Your 1 and 2-cost Inferno champions gain <TFTCurveTable row="ADAP"/> Attack Damage and Ability Power. The one who did the most damage last combat gains double. Gain a Varus and an Akali.

DA_18_LunarTraitAugment.description: Your Lunar champions gain <TFTCurveTable row="Health"/> Health and <TFTCurveTable row="DamageAmp" format="percent"/> Damage Amp for each unique Solar champion fielded. Gain a Leona, a Kayle, and a Diana.

DA_18_LunarTraitAugmentPlus.description: Your Lunar champions gain <TFTCurveTable row="Health"/> Health and <TFTCurveTable row="DamageAmp" format="percent"/> Damage Amp for each unique Solar champion fielded. Gain a Leona, a Kayle, and an Aphelios.

DA_18_PrimalAugment_Nidalee.description: Primal grants an additional Blessing. Gain a Vi now and a Nidalee after <TFTCurveTable row="AugmentRoundDelay"/> rounds.

DA_18_PrimalAugment_Sivir.description: Primal grants an additional Blessing.  Gain a Vi now and a Sivir after <TFTCurveTable row="AugmentRoundDelay"/> rounds.

DA_18_PrimalAugmentPlus_Nidalee.description: Primal grants an additional Blessing. Gain a Vi and a Nidalee.

DA_18_PrimalAugmentPlus_Sivir.description: Primal grants an additional Blessing. Gain a Vi and a Sivir.

DA_18_RiftbeastTraitAugment.description: You can now choose a second Alpha Riftbeast. Alpha Riftbeasts gain <TFTCurveTable row="BonusHP" format="percentMinusOne"/> max Health and <TFTCurveTable row="BonusAS" format="percentMinusOne"/> Attack Speed. Gain a Scuttlecrab, a Cinderling, and a Pebbles.

DA_18_RivalsAugment.description: You can field Rengar and Kha'Zix together with no penalties, and they gain bonuses when the other casts. Gain a Rengar and a Kha'Zix.

DA_18_RivalsAugmentPlus.description: You can field Rengar and Kha'Zix together with no penalties, and they gain bonuses when the other casts. Gain a Rengar and a Kha'Zix.

DA_18_SolarTraitAugment.description: Gain a Leona, a Kayle, and a Sejuani. Leona gains <TFTCurveTable row="FlatHealth"/> permanent max Health each round, increased by <TFTCurveTable row="HealthPerThreeStar"/> for each unique 3-star champion fielded.

DA_18_SprykinAugment.description: While Sprykin is active, gain a second BFF summon that is <TFTCurveTable row="Effectiveness_DoesntIncludeSummonSpell" format="percent"/> as powerful. Gain a Teemo, a Veigar, and a Kobuko.
